thread:
olivia: Quick reminder — release cutoff (v2026.3) is 18:00 PT today. After that only security/critical hotfixes via exceptions. Please get version bumps and changelog entries in before cutoff.

raj: Heads up — I still have a tiny bump for the redis client (2 LOC) and a changelog blurb. Is that safe to merge now?

olivia: If it's just a version and changelog, yes please merge to release/* and ping here. Make sure CI passes on the release branch.

raj: Pushing now. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123

sasha: FYI I have a late request from integrations for an optional telemetry flag. It's not critical for this release but they asked for a late-merge exception.

mike: What does "optional telemetry flag" change? runtime path?

sasha: It toggles a feature gate only in the CLI. No runtime behavior change, but it touches the cli package and requires a minor docs update.

jen: That sounds low-risk but still touches release artifacts. We should avoid piling changes. If integrations can ship it as a follow-up patch next week, prefer that.

olivia: Agreed with jen. We only allow late merges for security, critical bug fixes, or pre-approved hotfixes. If integrations want an exception, they must open an exceptions issue in the release board and have a release captain + eng lead sign-off.

sasha: Understood — I'll ask them to open the exception issue. Meanwhile, can we still take small version bumps?

olivia: Yes, small version bumps/changelog-only PRs are OK. Anything that modifies behavior needs the exception flow.

raj: CI is green on my bump, merging to release/2026.3 now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: merged PR #4123 into release/2026.3 — CI: ✅ — preflight: ✅

mike: Quick question about branch naming — should we use release/2026.3 or rel/2026.3? I've seen both.

olivia: Use release/2026.3 (we standardized that last quarter). I'll update the release checklist to call it out.

jen: Note for whoever handles the changelog: please include the revert note for the old metrics flag removal. We rolled it back in canary and want to document.

raj: Logged a changelog entry under doc/CHANGELOG.md — small blurb.

olivia: Thanks. Last call for merges: 17:30 PT. After that only exceptions via the release board and explicit sign-off by me + on-call eng lead.

sasha: If integrations open an exception, please @olivia @mike so we can triage quickly.

olivia: Yep. I'll be monitoring slack and the release board. If anyone hits merge conflicts with release/2026.3 ping me and we can coordinate a fast-forward/patch.

raj: One merge conflict with changelog order — resolving now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: preflight checks for release/2026.3 at 17:40 PT: flaky-test=1 (nonblocking), lint=0, build=0

mike: For visibility: if a late merge is approved, we'll run an isolated preflight and a smoke deploy to staging before bumping prod.

olivia: Good plan. Anyone planning anything that could add to token usage or cost metrics in prod please file an evaluation PR so Optimize gets a baseline.

jen: Copy — no heavy token changes in this release.

sasha: I'll have integrations open the exception issue if they insist, but we'll try to avoid it. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
